attribution: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) House Price Index, all-transactions, not seasonally adjusted: metropolitan area and state indices (quarterly) and the experimental five-digit ZIP code index (annual). US federal government work, public domain. ZIP codes are placed in metros with the US Census Bureau 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file and the July 2023 OMB core based statistical area delineations.
basis: FHFA House Price Index: all-transactions repeat-sales index (sales and appraisals on Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac mortgages), NSA

long_index.basis: FHFA all-transactions index for Nassau County-Suffolk County, NY (metropolitan division), quarterly from the first published quarter (thin samples before 1985)

name: Nassau County
notes: Nassau County: the city series is the FHFA all-transactions index for Nassau County-Suffolk County, NY (metropolitan division) (FHFA area code 35004), quarterly from 1985 Q1; the full history from the first published quarter is the long-history chart (1975-1984 values rest on thin samples). First-level areas: Nassau County-Suffolk County, NY (metropolitan division) with the other divisions of New York-Newark-Jersey City, NY-NJ and the New York state index. ZIP indices are annual, shown as flat quarters: each year's FHFA five-digit ZIP index value is repeated across its four quarters, so 12-month changes are year-over-year and quarterly changes within a year are zero. ZIP codes are Census ZCTAs placed in the metro by their county (739 ZIP codes with at least 5 years of index). Index levels are not comparable across areas: each series is rebased to 100 in the base period.
